title: Sale of a partnership interest — Farrah Cole
instructions: Farrah Cole sells her one-third interest in Delta Partners to an outsider for **$150,000** cash. Her share of partnership liabilities, **$30,000**, is assumed by the buyer.

exhibits.title: Facts
exhibits.content:
Farrah's outside basis (including her share of liabilities): **$90,000**.
Her share of appreciation in unrealized receivables and inventory (§751 hot assets): **$25,000**.

rows.label: Ordinary income under §751
rows.explanation: Her share of hot asset appreciation: **25,000**.
